comments.body:
The ETH Safety department(SGU) also has a emergency phone number that can be reached 24-7. Just dial 888 from any ETH phone, it should also be labeled on every phone. I believe all rooms at eth (still) have one. you can also reach the hotline at +**41 44 342 11 88**  from any mobile phone.   
There is also a non emergency phone number: +41 44 632 30 30 which might have been more appropriate in this situation. see more information here: [https://ethz.ch/en/the-eth-zurich/organisation/departments/safety-security-health-environment.html](https://ethz.ch/en/the-eth-zurich/organisation/departments/safety-security-health-environment.html)
